title: GNAT (gdb) debug configuration
description: Launch or attach to an Ada/SPARK program using gdb's native DAP mode. Requires gdb >= 14.

program.description: Absolute path to the executable produced by gprbuild. The `${ZED_GNAT_MAIN}` substitution resolves to the main attribute of the active .gpr.

preLaunchTask.description: Task to run before launch. Defaults to `gprbuild` on the active project.
